name: How much does a room addition cost in 2026?

mainEntity.name: How much does a room addition cost in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: $150–$400/sq ft depending on location/size; average 20x20 addition $100k–$250k including foundation, permits, finishes; 10–20% contingency recommended. 2mo​
